label: BUG
title: A round-robin rule whose condition is the SLA name does not assign a new ticket; it assigns only after the ticket is edited
date: TAVI 14 Nov 2026 (15:33–15:45 Cairo) · Zoho from help only, not checked live
env: staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging) · owner account · Edge · QA AS6 Dept A · ticket #3922 (QA, deleted after) · agents online

panels.caption: Round-robin rule, Dept A: runs on Ticket Create and Ticket Update; condition 2 is SLA Name is "QA AO OR13 SLA fi1u"
Round Robin page text: "Round robin runs after workflows and SLAs"
Ticket #3922 created 3:33 PM: SLA "QA AO OR13 SLA fi1u" applied on create, but Ticket Owner is Unassigned and History has no assignment
3:45 PM: the ticket is edited (priority) and the same rule assigns it to Test User 1 at once, trigger "The ticket was edited"

rows: Round-robin rule on Ticket Create, condition SLA Name is the policy
New ticket matches the SLA policy
Assigned by the round-robin rule (the SLA is already set)
Unassigned; no assignment entry in History
Assigned to Test User 1 by the same rule (12 min later, only because of the edit)
Order stated in TAVI and in Zoho's help
SLA first, then round robin, so round robin can use the SLA
Not true on create: round robin does not see the SLA
